title: Codimension-one holomorphic Anosov diffeomorphisms
summary: We prove that every codimension-one holomorphic Anosov diffeomorphism of a compact connected complex manifold is biholomorphically conjugate to a hyperbolic automorphism of a complex torus. This verifies a conjecture of Ghys in the codimension-one case and, in particular, in complex dimension three.
